## Addendum 2026-11-20 — silent_exit root-caused; battery re-run green on evidence

- **Root cause:** bare `setsid` in the deadline wrapper forks under
  `podman exec` (the exec'd process is already a process-group leader);
  the parent's immediate `0` exit made podman tear down the exec session
  and kill the live Pi/Claude tree before it emitted output.
- **Fix:** `setsid --wait timeout --kill-after` in
  `hharness_helper::podman::wrap_kill`; docs in `cell.rs`, `server.rs`,
  `protocol.rs`; argv goldens/stubs updated (`r6_39`, `r6_45j`,
  `exec_drain`).
- **Replay-lane correction:** lane `model` must spell the recorded
  model (`glm-5.3-flash`); `"replay"` minted unindexable attribution.
  Documented in the driver docstring.
- **AG6 fold basis:** `proxy_stats` counts durable
  `hh.model_proxy.receipt/1` docs per slot (mode-universal);
  `cost_attributed_count` reported separately — §4.9 replay mints no
  spend rows by contract.
- **Re-run evidence:** `docs/build/reports/2026-11-20-r6.55-w4x-pp0/`
  — 10/10 legs with `receipt_count ≥ 1` and `native_log_bytes > 0`;
  9/10 all-gates-pass. Held: `sm-429-claude-code`
  `withheld{admission:AG}` — typed `agent_timeout` on the injected 429
  (deadline path now provably delivers a typed cause). `SM-hang` still
  coverage-limited (recorded response diverged; `sleep` never
  consumed) — typed, not silent.
- Verification: fmt, r6_55/r6_39/r6_45j/exec_drain batteries, scoped
  clippy `-D warnings`, `check-fp-sweep.sh`, `check-live-evidence.sh`
  all PASS. Still $0 — replay only; no merge (`OPERATOR`).
